acl_0.description: First ACL entry allowing hosts to query ixfrdist.

acl_1.description: Second ACL entry allowing hosts to query ixfrdist.

axfr_max_records.description: Maximum number of records allowed in a single zone.

axfr_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for AXFR transactions.

failed_soa_retry.description: Time in seconds between retries of the SOA query for a zone.

compress.description: Whether record compression should be enabled.

keep.description: Amount of older copies/IXFR diffs to keep for every domain.

tcp_in_threads.description: Number of threads to spawn for TCP connections.

webserver_address.description: The IP address and port where the webserver should listen.

webserver_loglevel.description: How much the webserver should log: 'none', 'normal' or 'detailed'.
